diagnostic_resolutions.source_fragment:
nbody!(bodies, n) = for i=1:n
    advance!(bodies)
end
diagnostic_resolutions.resolution: The original short-form nbody! definition has a for expression as its body. The recognizer does not push this for opener because it follows =, so the loop end pops the package module and the final module end receives an unmatched-close diagnostic. The source itself has the correct nesting. Its raw two units on the definition line represent the expression-function definition and explicit loop header; its loop end and final module end each already retain one unit. This bookkeeping diagnostic therefore requires no numeric adjustment.

source_specific_review.scope: Exact source-specific review of the existing normalizer diagnostics; no new counter, tests, source mutations, native work or historical count rewriting. Original replay values and original diagnostics are retained.

narrow_source_correctness_review.fasta: Entry resets the existing Ref seed to Int32(42). random_fasta computes cumsum(pr) without mutating either original probability vector. Formal n binds the actual driver argument; no state from training is used as benchmark output.
narrow_source_correctness_review.binarytrees_distributed: The three original Node/make/check declarations now belong to the containing application module. The original @distributed reduction remains unchanged; no addprocs or workers are added. Default launch must retain the original single-process policy.
narrow_source_correctness_review.regex: The original Regex patterns, flags, constant collections and matching/replacement loops remain unchanged. Standard Base Regex compile methods reconstruct a native handle when its pointer is C_NULL. This static review does not substitute for the planned fresh-process output validation or claim that PCRE vendor JIT is Julia AOT.
narrow_source_correctness_review.streams: Reverse-complement references current process stdin/stdout at each operation and retains the original seek/position/read/write behavior; validator supplies a regular seekable file.
narrow_source_correctness_review.nbody: The existing constant Body vector is emptied and populated from the exact original body literal and sun initialization on every julia_main entry, before either energy print. The original advance, energy and iteration kernels remain unchanged.
narrow_source_correctness_review.pidigits: BigInt state is allocated inside pidigits on each call. Version4 uses the existing numDigits argument in its final partial-line count, removing dependence on the formerly top-level n binding.
